title: Identification of a Histone Deacetylase 8 Inhibitor through Drug Screenings Based on Machine Learning.
authors: Nurani, Atika; Yamashita, Yasunobu; Taki, Yuuki; Takada, Yuri; Itoh, Yukihiro; Suzuki, Takayoshi
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习筛选HDAC8小分子抑制剂，对象为酶-小分子互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA体系完全无关。
abstract: Histone deacetylase 8 (HDAC8) is a zinc-dependent HDAC that catalyzes the deacetylation of nonhistone proteins. It is involved in cancer development and HDAC8 inhibitors are promising candidates as anticancer agents. However, most reported HDAC8 inhibitors contain a hydroxamic acid moiety, which often causes mutagenicity. Therefore, we used machine learning for drug screening and attempted to identify non-hydroxamic acids as HDAC8 inhibitors. In this study, we established a prediction model based on the random forest (RF) algorithm for screening HDAC8 inhibitors because it exhibited the best predictive accuracy in the training dataset, including data generated by the synthetic minority over-sampling technique (SMOTE). Using the trained RF-SMOTE model, we screened the Osaka University library for compounds and selected 50 virtual hits. However, the 50 hits in the first screening did not show HDAC8-inhibitory activity. In the second screening, using the RF-SMOTE model, which was established by retraining the dataset including 50 inactive compounds, we identified non-hydroxamic acid 12 as an HDAC8 inhibitor with an IC(50) of 842 nM. Interestingly, its IC(50) values for HDAC1 and HDAC3-inhibitory activity were 38 and 12 microM, respectively, showing that compound 12 has high HDAC8 selectivity. Using machine learning, we expanded the chemical space for HDAC8 inhibitors and identified non-hydroxamic acid 12 as a novel HDAC8 selective inhibitor.
abstract_zh: 组蛋白去乙酰化酶8（HDAC8）是一种锌依赖性HDAC，催化非组蛋白的去乙酰化。它参与癌症发展，HDAC8抑制剂作为抗癌药物具有前景。然而，大多数已报道的HDAC8抑制剂含有异羟肟酸部分，这常导致致突变性。因此，我们使用机器学习进行药物筛选，并尝试鉴定非异羟肟酸类HDAC8抑制剂。在本研究中，我们基于随机森林（RF）算法建立了用于筛选HDAC8抑制剂的预测模型，因为该模型在训练数据集中表现出最佳的预测准确性，训练数据包括通过合成少数类过采样技术（SMOTE）生成的数据。利用训练好的RF-SMOTE模型，我们对大阪大学库中的化合物进行了筛选，并选出了50个虚拟命中物。然而，首次筛选中的50个命中物未显示出HDAC8抑制活性。在第二次筛选中，使用通过重新训练包含50个无活性化合物的数据集而建立的RF-SMOTE模型，我们鉴定出非异羟肟酸化合物12为HDAC8抑制剂，其IC(50)为842 nM。有趣的是，其对HDAC1和HDAC3抑制活性的IC(50)值分别为38和12微摩尔，表明化合物12具有高HDAC8选择性。通过机器学习，我们扩展了HDAC8抑制剂的化学空间，并鉴定出非异羟肟酸化合物12为一种新型HDAC8选择性抑制剂。
